text:
mila: FYI we're getting intermittent p99 token spikes (~2.1s) for a handful of tenants on eu-west dedicated racks during peak hours. They all run long-streaming jobs with lots of tiny packets.

devon: Can you share which hosts and what nets? seems like a NIC-level problem we've seen before.

mila: quick snapshot shows host eu-w-22 and eu-w-27 with repeated netdev_xmit throttles and high tx_queue_depth. GPU cycles look healthy. Prometheus samples: 
```
max_over_time(node_network_tx_queue_length{host=~"eu-w-2[0-9]"}[10m])
sum by(tenant) (rate(streamed_token_count{pool="dedicated-eu"}[1m]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(gen_request_latency_bucket{route="/stream"}[5m])) by (le, tenant))
```

anita: tagging infra-bot 82 -- can we do a NIC-remap soft canary for the top offender (tenant: vectra-ai)? move them to different vNIC assignment and split interrupts to avoid ring collision.

infra-bot: created INF-5012 (P2) 8; planned actions: soft_vnic_remap for tenant vectra-ai at 5055554380, apply transient egress shaping (15%) and schedule scheduler tweak 'nic-zone-split' for canary.

leo: if soft-remap buys time we should try a fractional-dedicated slice for 12h to validate cost vs customer impact. Fractional approx 0.33 unit-hr at peak vs full 1.0.

mila: starting canary now. applying remap on eu-w-22,27 and backfilling a small token-rate limiter for their route. Will check p99 in 10m.

sre-oncall: canary in progress. also enabling per-host irq_balance override to ensure NIC queues balanced across cores on the host.

5m update - mila: p99 dropped from ~2.1s -> ~480ms for vectra-ai after remap. tx_queue_length tail reduced.

devon: good sign. can we reproduce in a synthetic test? maybe spin 2 long-seq clients on same host to verify scheduler nic collision semantics.

leo: opened a small e2e job in CI to simulate ring fragmentation. if reproduced we can land a scheduler default that prefers nic anti-affinity when predicted long-seq fraction >10%.

anita: also add a short-term alert: netdev_tx_drop_rate > 0.5% on any dedicated host => auto-soft_remap attempt for top tenant. put backstop to avoid oscillation.

infra-bot: INF-5012 updated at 5055554599: canary healthy, p99 improved, scheduler-nic-zone-split PR #1021 opened, cost estimate attached. Next steps: 12h fractional slice test window for vectra-ai and follow-up on CI reproducer.

sre-oncall: thanks all  monitoring continues. :thumbsup:
